def transform(grid):

    # Find full separator and the non-background object on one side.
    hr=next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r]))==1 and grid[r][0]!=bg),None)
    if hr is not None:
        sep=grid[hr][0]
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,sep)]
        lo=min(r for r,c in pts); hi=max(r for r,c in pts)
        if lo>hr: shift=hr+1-lo
        else: shift=hr-1-hi
        for r,c in pts: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in pts: out[r+shift][c]=grid[r][c]
        edge=(hr+1 if lo>hr else hr-1)
        if 0<=edge<h: out[edge]=[8]*w
    else:
        vc=next(c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and grid[0][c]!=bg)
        sep=grid[0][vc]
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg,sep)]
        left=min(c for r,c in pts); right=max(c for r,c in pts)
        shift=(vc-1-right) if right<vc else (vc+1-left)
        for r,c in pts: out[r][c]=bg
